topics.title: count_bassed_sum.c

topics.title: Hello World
topics.description: The very first Python program: printing a greeting and taking user input. Introduces the print() and input() functions with basic string usage.

topics.title: Data Types Practice
topics.description: An introduction to Python data types: strings, integers, and type conversion. Demonstrates accessing characters by index and converting between types.

topics.title: Variable Swap Practice
topics.description: A classic beginner exercise that swaps the values of two variables using a temporary variable. Builds understanding of assignment and memory.

topics.title: Life in Weeks Calculator
topics.description: Given an age, calculates remaining days, weeks, and months assuming a 90-year lifespan. Practices basic arithmetic and string output formatting.

topics.title: Tip Calculator
topics.description: Calculates how much each person should pay including a chosen tip percentage. Practices float arithmetic, rounding, and formatted output.

topics.title: Odd or Even Check
topics.description: A program that checks whether a given number is odd or even using the modulo operator. A foundational exercise in conditionals and operators.

topics.title: Head or Tail Coin Flip
topics.description: Simulates a coin flip using random.randint and prints Head or Tail. Introduces the random module and simple conditional logic.

topics.title: BMI Calculator
topics.description: Calculates Body Mass Index from height and weight and categorizes the result as underweight, normal, overweight, or obese. Combines arithmetic and multi-branch conditionals.

topics.title: Pizza Order Calculator
topics.description: Calculates the total price of a pizza order based on size, pepperoni, and extra cheese selections. Reinforces if-elif-else logic and cumulative addition.

topics.title: Love Calculator
topics.description: A fun program that counts letters in "true" and "love" from two names and produces a love score. Practices string methods and conditionals.

topics.title: Random Bill Payer
topics.description: Randomly selects a person from a comma-separated list of names to pay the bill. Introduces random.choice and string splitting.

topics.title: Treasure Island Adventure
topics.description: A text-based adventure game where choices determine whether the player finds treasure or meets their end. Solidifies understanding of nested if-else branching.

topics.title: If Statement Practice
topics.description: Checks height and age for a rollercoaster ride, calculates ticket price, and offers a photo add-on. A practical multi-condition exercise.

topics.title: Leap Year Check
topics.description: Determines whether a year is a leap year using divisibility rules: divisible by 4, not by 100, unless also by 400. Teaches compound boolean expressions.

topics.title: Treasure Map Game
topics.description: Places a treasure marker on a 3×3 grid by converting user row/column input to list indices. Introduces 2D lists and index manipulation.

topics.title: List Introduction
topics.description: Demonstrates creating a list of Indian states and accessing elements using both positive and negative indices. A clean introduction to Python lists.

topics.title: Sum of Even Numbers
topics.description: Calculates the sum of all even numbers from 1 to 100 using a for loop and modulo filtering. Combines loops with conditional logic.

topics.title: Average Height with Built-ins
topics.description: Calculates the average height of a list of students using Python built-in functions sum() and len(). Demonstrates the power of built-in functions for clean code.

topics.title: Average Height Without Built-ins
topics.description: Calculates average height manually using a loop accumulator without sum() or len(). Deepens understanding of how built-in functions work internally.

topics.title: Find Highest Score
topics.description: Finds the highest score in a list of student scores without using the built-in max() function. Builds algorithmic thinking from scratch.

topics.title: FizzBuzz
topics.description: The classic FizzBuzz challenge: print Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for multiples of 5, FizzBuzz for both, and the number otherwise. Tests logical condition ordering.

topics.title: Rock Paper Scissors
topics.description: A text-based Rock Paper Scissors game against the computer with ASCII art displays. Consolidates conditionals, random choice, and user input handling.

topics.title: Password Generator
topics.description: Generates a random password with a user-specified number of letters, symbols, and numbers. Offers easy (ordered) and hard (shuffled) modes.

topics.title: Hangman Step 1
topics.description: First step of building Hangman: randomly choose a word and check if a single guessed letter is in the word. Introduces the in operator with strings.

topics.title: Hangman Step 2
topics.description: Adds a display list of underscores and reveals correctly guessed letters in their positions. Builds on step 1 with list manipulation.

topics.title: Hangman Step 3
topics.description: Adds a while loop so the player keeps guessing until the word is fully revealed. Introduces loop termination based on a win condition.

topics.title: Hangman Step 4
topics.description: Completes the Hangman mechanics by adding a lives counter and ASCII art stages that update with each wrong guess.

topics.title: Hangman Game
topics.description: The complete polished Hangman game with logo, word list, lives, and ASCII art stages. Combines all previous steps into a fully playable game.

topics.title: Formatted Name Practice
topics.description: Takes a first and last name and returns them formatted in title case. A gentle introduction to defining and calling functions with return values.

topics.title: Basic Calculator
topics.description: A simple four-operation calculator using functions stored in a dictionary. Demonstrates how to map operators to functions for clean dispatch logic.

topics.title: Days in Month Calculator
topics.description: Determines the number of days in any given month for any year, accounting correctly for leap years. Combines function design with list indexing.

topics.title: Turtle Hello World
topics.description: First steps with the Turtle graphics module: importing, creating a Turtle object, and calling movement methods. A graphical equivalent of Hello World.

topics.title: Turtle Library Overview
topics.description: Explores Turtle module attributes: printing the turtle object reference and reading screen canvas dimensions. Builds familiarity with the turtle environment.

topics.title: Turtle Import Styles
topics.description: Demonstrates three ways to import the Turtle module: import turtle, from turtle import Turtle, and import turtle as t. Clarifies Python import mechanics.

topics.title: Turtle Shape and Color
topics.description: Customises a turtle by changing its shape and color before drawing. Introduces turtle appearance methods for more expressive graphics.

topics.title: Turtle Square Challenge
topics.description: Draws a square by repeating forward and right-turn movements in a for loop. A focused challenge connecting loop logic with turtle geometry.

topics.title: Dash Line Drawing
topics.description: Draws a dashed line by alternating penup() and pendown() calls inside a loop. Teaches pen control for non-continuous drawing.

topics.title: Drawing Different Shapes
topics.description: Draws polygons from triangle to decagon, each with a random color. Applies the exterior angle formula (360 / sides) and nested loops.

topics.title: Random Walk
topics.description: A turtle that moves in random directions (up, down, left, right) producing an unpredictable colored path. Introduces algorithmic randomness in graphics.

topics.title: Random Color Walk
topics.description: Extends the random walk by generating a random RGB color for each step. Introduces colormode(255) and dynamic color generation.

topics.title: Turtle Race
topics.description: A turtle racing game where the user bets on a color and multiple turtles race across the screen with random step sizes. Introduces multiple turtle objects.

topics.title: Turtle Keyboard Events
topics.description: Demonstrates setting up keyboard event listeners with screen.listen() and screen.onkey(). A foundation for building interactive turtle applications.

topics.title: Etch A Sketch App
topics.description: A keyboard-controlled drawing app using W/A/S/D keys to move the turtle and C to clear the screen. A complete interactive turtle application.

topics.title: Spirograph
topics.description: Creates a colorful spirograph pattern by drawing circles with a small heading change each iteration. Combines loops, geometry, and random color generation.

topics.title: Number Guessing Game Explained
topics.description: A heavily commented number guessing implementation that explains variable scope, function definitions, and global variables in detail.

topics.title: Number Guessing Game
topics.description: Two implementations of a number guessing game with limited attempts and difficulty selection. Covers while loops, conditionals, and modular function design.

topics.title: Variable Scope
topics.description: Three files demonstrating Python scope rules: global vs local, block scope absence, and modifying globals. Covers the LEGB rule in practice.

topics.title: Debugging Exercises
topics.description: A collection of buggy programs covering off-by-one errors, type mismatches, indentation errors, and logical mistakes — each paired with a corrected version.

topics.title: Higher Lower Game
topics.description: A game where the player guesses which celebrity has more social media followers. Uses lists of dictionaries, score tracking, and a continuous game loop.

topics.title: Blackjack Game
topics.description: A text-based Blackjack (21) game against the computer. Implements card drawing, Ace value adjustment (11→1), and computer AI that draws until 17.

topics.title: Painting Project
topics.description: Extracts a color palette from an image using the colorgram library and recreates it as a dot painting with turtle. Combines external libraries with turtle graphics.

topics.title: OOP User Class
topics.description: Defines a User class with id, username, followers, and following attributes, plus a follow() method. A clean introduction to object-oriented programming.

topics.title: Quiz Game
topics.description: A True/False quiz game built with OOP across four files: Question model, QuizBrain controller, question data, and main entry point. Demonstrates real multi-file Python project structure.

topics.title: PrettyTable Demo
topics.description: Uses the PrettyTable library to display structured tabular data with a Pokémon example. Introduces third-party library usage and table formatting.
